# Written coverage exclusions for the counted (proven) run. Each entry is bound
# to the sha256 of its source lines (joined with LF): an edit to an excluded
# line makes the entry stale and the gate fails until it is re-justified.

column5: implicit else of `if let Some(permissions)`: in fix mode permissions is always Some (check mode returned earlier)
u64 at or below 2^53-1 is always also an i64, so the first branch takes it
serde_json::Number cannot hold a non-finite double (Number::from_f64 refuses NaN and infinities)
implicit else after as_f64(): a serde_json::Number is always i64, u64 or f64
u64 at or below 2^53-1 is always also an i64, so the first branch takes it
es_number_to_string is only called with a Number's f64, which is always finite
JCS output is built from UTF-8 strings and ASCII escapes, so from_utf8 cannot fail
Visitor::expecting is only called for a type mismatch; serde_json's deserialize_any always picks the matching visit_* method
a comma at nesting depth 0 is impossible in text that has already parsed as JSON
